summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to study the Lower Presidio Historic Park in Monterey, California, to determine its national significance and suitability for inclusion in the National Park System.

scores.thoughts: The bill mentions the establishment of the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary and its protection of cultural, archeological, and historic resources, including shipwrecks. This is a minor reference within a bill primarily focused on historical preservation and a special resource study, so its impact on environmental protection is very tangential.
